critique.evidence: The headline, 48-vector scope, filtering instruction, selected-vector detail, observable signals, and “Continue to scored replay” CTA establish a coherent journey. However, desktop vector cards are visibly clipped on the left, the desktop stage filter says “All stages” while a specific vector detail is already open, and mobile/tablet replace the kill-chain diagram with an unlabeled numbered grid whose selection state is not visually obvious. Terms such as “context manip” and “agentic” also require domain familiarity. The mobile header hides most destinations behind horizontal scrolling despite the swipe cue.
critique.fix: Make the selected stage and vector unmistakable across all viewports, fix desktop card clipping, use full stage names or provide plain-language labels, and keep the stage visualization semantically consistent between desktop and smaller screens. Add a clearer mobile navigation affordance showing that more destinations exist.
